reason: NONE. First thing I noticed is that it's capsules, 2 of them every day, and I hate swallowing pills, so that's a no before I even get to the box. The sachet and the QR are cute, but I don't see the size of the capsules anywhere.
objection: Two capsules a day when I can barely get pills down. A QR code and 'lab-tested' sounds like marketing, everyone says tested.
would_change_my_mind: A powder or drink mix, or gummies, in the same sachet.
